prompt.text:
Implement a new function `visibleOutline(roots, expanded): readonly OutlineRow[]` and export `OutlineNode` and `OutlineRow`. A node has `id`, `label`, `kind` (`"group"`, `"device"`, or `"metric"`), and readonly children. A row has `id`, `label`, `icon`, `depth`, `expandable`, and `expanded`. Use icons `folder`, `chip`, and `gauge` respectively. Traverse roots and children in pre-order, preserving supplied order. Include roots unconditionally; include a node's children only when its id is in `expanded`. A leaf is never reported expanded even if its id is in the set. Reject blank ids or labels, duplicate ids, and cyclic object references with `RangeError("Invalid outline")`, including invalid nodes hidden beneath collapsed ancestors. Empty roots return an empty array. Do not mutate inputs or expose node objects through the result.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
